build_patchconvnet_s60: build a PatchConvnet S60 model with 384 embed dim and 60 depth convolution blocks
build_patchconvnet_b60: build a PatchConvnet B60 model with 768 embed dim and 60 depth convolution blocks
build_patchconvnet_l120: build a PatchConvnet L120 model with 1024 embed dim and 120 depth convolution blocks
create_convstem: create a ConvStem module to project images into patch embeddings using stacked 3x3 convolutions
create_learned_aggregation_layer: create a Learned_Aggregation_Layer that computes single-head attention from a cls token to patch tokens
